idle_h3_v1.action: A poised duelist's idle that loops. She breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, she rolls the sabre wrist so the blade turns a little and lifts the buckler slightly, the head turns to watch, the tabard panels stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original guard stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with light, quick steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The sabre is held low behind and the buckler forward; the scarf and tabard panels swing behind. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE sabre slash toward screen right. hit_h3_v1.action: She starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The head snaps back, the shoulders twist away and the knees flex while she keeps hold of the sabre and the buckler, then she rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Raise the mirrored buckler in front of the face, bend the knees deep and draw the sabre across the body beneath it, then hold the low covered guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A duelist's salute. She brings the sabre up vertical in front of her face with the blade pointing to the sky and opens the buckler arm out to the side, holds the salute briefly, then lowers the sabre back to the original low guard stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly from standing. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
